technical_and_design_decisions: Execute performance benchmarking comparing Kafka 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 using automated test scripts across the three payload types (baseline, Tuple, Serialized) and three transport options (In-Memory, Direct Binding, Kafka) targeting the HDFS sink.
Upgrade Reactor dependency in build scripts to version 2.0.3 and resolve any deprecated API usages or signature mismatches.
Modify Spring XD default configuration properties (`xd.jmx.enabled=false`) to disable JMX by default, while preserving configuration flags for users to explicitly enable it.
Debug and fix the Gradle build script tasks (`dist` and `distZip`) to resolve local packaging and publication failures.
Refactor RPM startup/service scripts to support instance identifiers and configurable port offsets/directories, enabling multiple xd-container processes on a single VM/node.
Consolidate and update documentation in AsciiDoc/Markdown for OOTB batch jobs and UI Analytics tab widgets.
assumptions: A suitable test environment with Hadoop HDFS and Kafka clusters is available for conducting performance benchmark runs.
A single developer will perform all implementation, benchmarking, build repairs, RPM script updates, and documentation work.
Estimates are given in standard 8-hour workdays.
All changes target the Spring XD codebase repository.

activities.activity_description: Configure test matrices, execute performance test runs for baseline, Tuple, and Serialized payloads against In-Memory, Direct Binding, and Kafka transports to HDFS sink, comparing Kafka 0.8.1 vs 0.8.2.
Update Reactor dependency to 2.0.3 in build files, update any modified internal APIs, and verify system integration and test suite execution.
Update default XD container/server settings to disable JMX by default, update unit/integration tests expecting JMX, and verify performance throughput.
Investigate and resolve issues causing failures in `./gradlew dist` and `./gradlew distZip` targets, ensuring local archives build cleanly.

activities.activity_name: Clean Up Compiler and Javadoc Warnings (U5)
activities.activity_description: Identify and resolve Java compiler deprecation/type warnings and Javadoc syntax/missing tag warnings across all project modules.
Update RPM init/service scripts and template configs to allow specifying instance names, ports, and data directories for running multiple xd-containers on one host.
Author and organize documentation covering Out-Of-The-Box batch job definitions, parameters, and execution details.
Document the Analytics tab features, detailing stream pipeline widgets, counter/gauge visualizations, and configuration options.
Perform full automated build verification, package generation checks, and smoke testing of updated RPM scripts and configuration defaults.
